label: 响应式 1440 · 学习空间
expr: (function(){var de=document.documentElement;var iw=window.innerWidth;var over=[];Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.page *'),function(e){var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0&&r.right>iw+1)over.push(e.tagName+'.'+String(e.className).split(' ')[0]+'@'+r.right.toFixed(0));});return 'innerWidth='+iw+' scrollWidth='+de.scrollWidth+' 横向溢出='+(de.scrollWidth>iw+1)+' 越界元素数='+over.length+(over.length?'\n  '+over.slice(0,6).join('\n  '):'');})()

label: 响应式 1280 · 知识图谱
expr: (function(){var de=document.documentElement;var iw=window.innerWidth;var svg=document.getElementById('graphSvg');var sr=svg.getBoundingClientRect();var L=Array.prototype.map.call(svg.querySelectorAll('.node-label'),function(t){var r=t.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.left,y:r.top,w:r.width,h:r.height};});var D=Array.prototype.map.call(svg.querySelectorAll('.node-dot'),function(c){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.left,y:r.top,w:r.width,h:r.height};});function ov(a,b){return a.x-1<b.x+b.w&&b.x-1<a.x+a.w&&a.y-1<b.y+b.h&&b.y-1<a.y+a.h;}var ll=0,ld=0;for(var i=0;i<L.length;i++){for(var j=i+1;j<L.length;j++){if(ov(L[i],L[j]))ll++;}for(var j=0;j<D.length;j++){if(i===j)continue;if(ov(L[i],D[j]))ld++;}}var esc=0;L.forEach(function(a){if(a.x<sr.left-1||a.x+a.w>sr.right+1||a.y<sr.top-1||a.y+a.h>sr.bottom+1)esc++;});return 'innerWidth='+iw+' scrollWidth='+de.scrollWidth+' 横向溢出='+(de.scrollWidth>iw+1)+'\n  SVG='+sr.width.toFixed(0)+'x'+sr.height.toFixed(0)+' 标签重叠='+ll+' 标签压点='+ld+' 越界='+esc;})()
